description: OpenSSL 3.4.0 rejects unexpected alert(close_notify) messages in TLS 1.3 after a successful handshake, failing with 'unexpected message' error at record layer, while LibreSSL correctly processes them. This divergence occurs when client sends close_notify alerts after the connection is established.
criteria_summary: tls_version=V1_3 + first_to_fail=openssl340 + ossl_error contains 'unexpected message' + failing_input contains 'fn_alert_close_notify' (OSSL)
python_condition:
AllC(
    CheckAgentC(["protocol_config", "tls_version"], "V1_3"),
    StatusC(OSSL, in_error="unexpected message", first_executed_steps=None),
    TermContainsC(OSSL, "fn_alert_close_notify", last_input_executed=True)
)
